title: SavedProfile
description: A named profile belonging to an account. Identity and wording live here; what the scoring engine actually reads is the ActivityProfile inside it, defined once and shared with every request that carries one.

id.description: UUIDv7, generated on the device so a guest can create one with no network and signing up later renumbers nothing (ADR-0015).

name.description: What the person calls it — "Sabah koşusu" — not the activity slug.

updated_at.description: The field conflicts are resolved on. Last write wins per record (ADR-0015), so a client sending an older value than the server holds is told about the newer one rather than overwriting it.
